analysis: Read-only audit of saved candidate checks; no generation, validation rerun, simulation or physical trial.
definition: For each passing pose alpha=max over both selected first-contact witnesses of acos(clamp(normal_alignment,-1,1)), in degrees. Family counts use existing family_id; thresholds1/3/5deg are descriptive diagnostics, not newly validated acceptance limits.
important_limits: normal_alignment describes a selected CAD triangle witness, not the entire pad contact patch or force distribution.
Native sampled-pair tilt before horizontal projection is different from actual first-contact normal error after the Panda adapter.
Selected-witness transverse separation does not prove absent shared support, instability or displacement: a pad may have multiple simultaneous contacts.
No friction coefficient, force balance, disturbance robustness, in-hand motion or assembly precision is measured.
95/96 is modeled candidate availability for12CADparts across8placements; it is not a pickup-success rate or an all14parts result.
